decisions.inventory: 800 explicit cards in 12 collector families: base 150; Gold Portraits, Premiere Date and Silver Portraits 150 each; Artist's Canvas 20; Canvas Proofs 20; Extreme Action 20; PS-2000 Action 60; New Wave, Rookies, Stars and Reserve 20 each. All full parallel rosters independently fetched, not extrapolated.
decisions.rookies: Only base #48 Juan Sosa is a true RC, matching the separate rookie index and Beckett listing. Twenty-five scattered ROO/SP labels retained as Rookies/Prospects subsets on base and matching full parallels. No false RC suffixes on marketed mini Rookies or parallels.
decisions.namesTeams: Every base/insert tuple compared with complete supplementary tables; base and seven insert rosters independently compared with BCP. All full-base parallels compared to matching base identities/teams. Canvas Proofs match independently listed Canvas roster and own complete table. Historical franchises retained; punctuation and explicit Bob/Bobby Abreu, Tony Armas/Jr., David/Dave Nilsson aliases only. Gold Portraits #44 TCDB mislabels Dante Bichette; reviewed original front/back identify Pedro Astacio, Colorado Rockies, #44, 27/99. Correct output with explicit fail-closed source exception; raw row retained.
decisions.packConfiguration: BCP lists 24 packs per box, seven cards per pack, MSRP $4.49. Reviewed retail wrapper and blaster explicitly say five cards; small Hobby box scan does not resolve Hobby count. Seven is a provisional catalogue Hobby value, NOT visually verified. Do not assume five full-size plus two minis. Release blocked until physical Hobby configuration is resolved.
decisions.packOdds: Verified representable Hobby odds: Premiere Date 1:24, Reserve 1:25, Canvas 1:49. Extreme Action printed 2:25 and PS-2000 Action two per pack cannot be represented by integer one-in-N ProductSet denominators and therefore remain null, NOT rounded or split. Unknown rates and retail-only Silver stay null. All documented physical rates retained in source snapshot; original prospect collation not modeled.
decisions.exclusions: Exclude 20 PS-2000 Rookies Embossed Samples, promotional SAM cards without /99 stamping. Chicago SportsFest 2000 booth would emboss any eligible purchased/opened card: not a bounded regular pack-issued parallel. Do not fabricate a 150-card show family. No additional verified pack-issued autograph, memorabilia or hologram family; do not mix other years or sports.
decisions.verificationLimit: Complete catalogue/tuple checklist audit with normalized source records and SHA256 retrieval provenance. Five original packaging scans inspected; no full physical-card scan audit claimed. Hobby pack-count discrepancy and unsupported odds remain explicit release blockers. Gold #44 front/back visually audited to resolve the source error.
decisions.release: Unreleased draft for pricing/image harvesting; pack QA, images and pricing remain pending. No production database access or deployment.
